Skipping download\"; exit 0; fi; Asset=\"openOMSI-{{ServerVersion}}-server-linux-x64.zip\"; Url=\"https://github.com/openOMSI-Project/openOMSI/releases/download/v{{ServerVersion}}/$Asset\"; echo \"Downloading $Asset ...\"; curl -L --fail --progress-bar -o ./openomsi-server.zip \"$Url\" || { echo \"Download failed from GitHub (check the version number - $Url). This is a fault with the download, not AMP.\" >&2; exit 1; }; rm -f ./openomsi; unzip -oq ./openomsi-server.zip -d . && rm -f ./openomsi-server.zip && chmod +x ./openomsi && printf \"%s\" \"{{ServerVersion}}\" > ./.installedversion && echo \"openOMSI server {{ServerVersion}} installed\""

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullRootDir}}'; $InstalledVersion = ''; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath './.installedversion' -PathType Leaf) { $InstalledVersion = Get-Content -LiteralPath './.installedversion' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath './openomsi.exe' -PathType Leaf) -and ($InstalledVersion -eq '{{ServerVersion}}')) { Write-Output \"openOMSI server {{ServerVersion}} is already installed. Skipping download\"; exit 0 }; $Asset = \"openOMSI-{{ServerVersion}}-server-windows-x64.zip\"; $Url = \"https://github.com/openOMSI-Project/openOMSI/releases/download/v{{ServerVersion}}/$Asset\"; Write-Output \"Downloading $Asset ...\"; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $Url -OutFile './openomsi-server.zip' -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from GitHub (check the version number - $Url). This is a fault with the download, not AMP.\"; exit 1 }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath './openomsi.exe') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath './openomsi.exe' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath './openomsi-server.zip' -DestinationPath '.' -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath './openomsi-server.zip' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Content -LiteralPath './.installedversion' -Value '{{ServerVersion}}' -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline -Force; Write-Output \"openOMSI server {{ServerVersion}} installed\""
